decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is at the core of the firm's announced move toward accessible, low-profile systems, so management will persist even though the line has had little visibility since 2019.
The designer shower drain is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's design-led direction, and the heavy investment and visible commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.

The DallSafe 200 basement drain was launched with its own page and a specific public announcement, and it addresses lasting safety needs, so management will keep it and treat weak results as temporary.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral and only mentioned on the website, but it is cheap to keep and complements the drainage range, so it stays despite little commitment.
